department: Doctoral Programme in Engineering (ENG), School of Engineering

deadline.value: Application round 9 Sep to 3 Nov 2026 (23:59 GMT+2), decisions in November. 2027 rounds were not yet published.

gre_subject.value: Not stated on the page checked

supervisor.value: You need a supervising professor who is willing to supervise you before you apply for the study right.
supervisor.quote: You need to have a supervising professor who is willing to supervise your doctoral studies

funding.value: Funding is not automatic: full-time doctoral students need funding allocated (project funding, grant or employer). No tuition fees.
funding.quote: Full-time doctoral students need to have funding allocated for the doctoral studies | Most Aalto doctoral students combine different funding sources during their studies. | Aalto University doctoral studies are free of tuition fees.

entry_route.value: A relevant master's degree (four years plus a master's thesis for non-Bologna countries) is needed.
entry_route.quote: A degree earned abroad in a country that does not follow the Bologna Process must include a minimum of four years of studies and a master’s thesis

notes: Umbrella programme of the Departments of Mechanical Engineering, Civil Engineering and Built Environment; research fields include mechanical engineering and civil, water and environmental engineering.
